h:
这个工作流程整洁且相当紧凑。我尽力保持它尽可能干净。它包括样式选择器和几个效率节点。您最多可以添加四个洛拉（如果您愿意，也可以添加零个洛拉 - 如果没有洛拉，只需将下拉菜单保留为“无”）。

要使此工作流程正常工作，您需要安装“SDXL Prompt Styler”：https://github.com/twri/sdxl_prompt_styler以及“效率节点”：https://github.com/LucianoCirino/efficiency-nodes-comfyui因此，如果您希望工作流程正常运行，您需要首先执行此操作。我知道下载其他东西很痛苦，但样式选择器和效率节点值得付出努力，IMO！ :)

我还强烈推荐“ComfyUI-Manager”：https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager.git如果您缺少任何节点，它会让您知道缺少哪些节点，并为您提供缺少节点的快速一键安装选项。

ZIP 包括 SDXL Prompt Styler 的风格扩展，添加了 70 多种艺术风格。请阅读随附的自述文件以获取使用提示！ :)

如果您在测试后有时间，请留下评分！如果您喜欢这个或从中获得一些创意乐趣，请考虑捐赠：https://ko-fi.com/divaai这确实有助于我为人工智能社区创造更多资产！

~ 女主角

o.en:
This workflow is tidy and fairly compact. I did my best to keep it as clean as possible. It includes the style selector and a couple of Efficiency Nodes. You can add up to four loras (or have ZERO loras if you prefer - for no Loras just leave the drop down menu at "none").

For this workflow to work you need to have "SDXL Prompt Styler" installed:https://github.com/twri/sdxl_prompt_styleras well as "Efficiency Nodes":https://github.com/LucianoCirino/efficiency-nodes-comfyuiSo you'll need to do that first if you want the workflow to work. I know it's a pain to have to download other things, but the style selector and Efficiency Nodes are worth the effort, IMO! :)

I also highly recommend the "ComfyUI-Manager":https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager.gitIf you're missing any nodes it will let you know which ones you're missing and will give you a quick one-click install option for the missing nodes.

The ZIP includes a style expansion for the SDXL Prompt Styler that adds over 70 art styles. Please read the included READ ME for usage tips! :)

If you have a minute after testing this out, please leave a rating!And if you enjoy this or get some creative fun out of it please consider donating:https://ko-fi.com/divaaiIt would really help to keep me making more assets for the AI community!

~ Diva
